entries.name: Constructor's Implements
entries: Constructor's implements include all of the necessary components to build furnitures and structures.

entries.name: Lore
entries: This tool proficiency aids you in identifying the use and the origin of buildings and structures.

entries.name: Investigation/Perception
entries: You gain additional insight when inspecting areas within structures, because you know tricks of construction that can conceal areas from discovery.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

entries.name: Temporary Shelter
entries: Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15

As part of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can construct a lean-to or a similar shelter to keep your group dry and in the shade for the duration of the rest. Because it was fashioned quickly from whatever wood was available, the shelter collapses 1d3 days after being assembled.

rows: Chisel a small hole in a wall
Find a weak point in a wall

entries.name: Cybertech's Implements
entries: {@item Cybertech's implements|sw5e-phb} include all of the necessary components to modify and maintain datacrons and wristpads.

entries.name: Lore
entries: Your knowledge allows you greater insight into the history and origin of datacrons.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: Your use of tools allows you to more accurately discern illusions within 5 feet of you for what they are.

entries.name: Technology
entries: Your {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} grants you greater insight into the enhanced properties of wristpads.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

entries.name: Demolitions Kit
entries: Demolitions kits includes all of the necessary components to create, set, and disarm explosives. It contains a plastic face guard and heavy duty gloves, as well as precision cutting and gripping tools, and various common components of grenades and mines.

entries.name: Lore
entries: Your knowledge of explosives grants you insight when answering questions about the most effective explosives for a given task.

entries.name: Investigation and Perception
entries: You gain additional insight when looking for mines and charges, because you have learned a variety of common signs that betray their presence.

Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15 {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} check to temporarily improve one grenade or mine. To use this benefit, you must have a {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} with you, and the object must be within reach. If the explosive is detonated before the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, it deals bonus damage. This bonus is a die, with a maximum value equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If you have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the tool, this die's maximum is instead equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Disguise Kit
entries: Disguise kits includes all of the necessary components to create and apply a disguise. It includes cosmetics, hair dye, and small props that let you create disguises that change your physical appearance, in addition to a tool that lets them holographically mimic clothing.

entries.name: Deception
entries: In certain cases, a disguise can improve your ability to weave convincing lies.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries: The right disguise can make you look more fearsome, whether you want to scare someone away by posing as a plague victim or intimidate a gang of thugs by taking the appearance of a bully.

entries.name: Persuasion
entries: Folk tend to trust a person in uniform. If you disguise yourself as an authority figure, your efforts to persuade others are often more effective.

Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15 {@item Disguise kit|sw5e-phb|disguise kit} check to craft a disguise that mimics the appearance of a creature you spent at least 1 hour observing. To use this benefit, you must have a {@item Disguise kit|sw5e-phb|disguise kit} with you. On a success, you can don or doff this disguise as an action. Additionally, once before your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can gain a bonus to one check to pass yourself off as that creature. This bonus is a die, with a maximum value equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If you have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the tool, this die's maximum is instead equal to twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

rows: Spot a disguise being used by someone else

entries.name: Forgery Kit
entries: A {@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb|forgery kit} includes all of the necessary components to craft and identify forged documents, including copying a person's seal or signature.

entries.name: Deception
entries: A well-crafted forgery, such as papers proclaiming you to be a noble or a writ that grants you safe passage, can lend credence to a lie.

entries.name: Lore
entries: A {@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb|forgery kit} combined with your knowledge of history improves your ability to create fake historical documents or to tell if an old document is authentic.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: When you examine objects, proficiency with a {@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb|forgery kit} is useful for determining how an object was made and whether it is genuine.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

entries.name: Quick Fake
entries: Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15

As a part of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can produce a forged document no more than one page in length. As a part of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can produce a document that is up to four pages long. Your Intelligence check using a {@item Forgery kit|sw5e-phb|forgery kit} determines the DC for someone else's Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check to spot the fake.

entries.name: Investigation

entries: This kit contains all of the commonly required tools to make repairs on constructs, such as ships, speeders, and turrets. entries: Your skill allows you to more readily discern the make and model of vehicle and ship parts.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: Your experience lets you more readily identify aftermarket modifications in vehicles and ships.

entries.name: Technology
entries: Your experience grants you greater insight when conducting repairs on ships or vehicles.

entries.name: Poisoner's Kit
entries: A {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit} includes all of the necessary components to craft and store poisons.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: Your knowledge of poisons has taught you to handle those substances carefully, giving you an edge when you inspect {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} objects or try to extract clues from events that involve poison.

entries.name: Medicine
entries: When you treat the victim of a poison, your knowledge grants you added insight into how to provide the best care to your patient.

entries.name: Nature
entries: Working with poisons enables you to acquire lore about which plants and animals are poisonous.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15 {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit} check to temporarily improve the potency of one dose of poison. To use this benefit, you must have a {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit}, and the poison must be within reach. If the poison is applied before the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, its DC becomes 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier, and it deals extra poison damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. Additionally, you can improve the capability of one dose of poison. To use this benefit, you must have a poisoner—s kit, and the poison must be within reach. If the poison is applied before the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} made to resist your poison. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Security Kit
entries: A {@item Security kit|sw5e-phb|security kit} include all of the necessary components to set or disarm locks and traps.

entries.name: Lore
entries: Your knowledge of traps grants you insight when answering questions about locations that are renowned for their traps.

entries.name: Investigation and Perception
entries: You gain additional insight when looking for traps, because you have learned a variety of common signs that betray their presence.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

entries.name: Set a Trap
entries: Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can make a DC 15

Just as you can disable traps, you can also set them. As part of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can create a trap using items you have on hand. The total of your check becomes the DC for someone else's attempt to discover or disable the trap. The trap deals damage appropriate to the materials used in crafting it (such as poison or a weapon) or damage equal to half the total of your check, whichever the DM deems appropriate.

entries: A {@item Slicer's kit|sw5e-phb|slicer's kit} includes all of the necessary components to interface with and disarm digital securities.

entries.name: Lore
entries: Your knowledge of digital securities grants you insight when answering questions about them.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: You gain additional insight when looking for digital securities when using computers and terminals.

entries.name: Technology
entries: Your knowledge of common digital security types makes it easier for you to identify them.
{@i Feature that utilizes the tool in some capacity.}

entries: Surveyor's implements include all of the necessary components to draw and store maps.

entries.name: Lore
entries: You can use your knowledge of maps and locations to unearth more detailed information. For instance, you might spot hidden messages in a map, identify when the map was made to determine if geographical features have changed since then, and so forth.

entries.name: Nature
entries: Your familiarity with physical geography makes it easier for you to answer questions or solve issues relating to the terrain around you.

entries.name: Survival
entries: Your understand of geography makes it easier to find paths to civilization, to predict reas where towns might be found, and to avoid becoming lost. You have studied so many maps that common patterns, such as how trade routes evolve and where settlements arise in relation to gegraphic locations, are familiar to you.

entries: Synthweaver's implements include all of the necessary components to craft and repair clothing and boots.

entries.name: Lore
entries: Your {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} lends you additional insight when examining clothes and boots.

entries.name: Investigation
entries: Using your knowledge of the process of creating cloth objects, you can spot clues and make deductions that others would overlook when you examine tapestries, upholstery, clothing, and other woven items, or examining the wear of clothing and boots.

The DC to find the hidden compartment is equal to 8 + your bonus to checks with synthweaver's implements at the time of creation.

entries.name: Lore
entries: You can determine the age and origin of objects, even if you have only a few pieces remaining from the original.

entries.name: Investigation/Perception
entries: You are more effective at identifying traps concealed by debris.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries: You are more effective at hiding traps that you place.

entries.name: Multitool
entries: You can use {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} as other tools with which you are proficient. You still make the {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with the other tool, but you do not require a physical set of the other tools. If you have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the other tools, you must also have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} to gain the benefit of that {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} when using {@item Tinker's implements|sw5e-phb|tinker's implements} in this way.
With access to your tools, you can repair small items. For any object, you need access to raw materials required to repair it.
